notes.title: First Update - v1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! INX has been just updated today, based on your feedback.

The following adjustments were made:

-The hitbox size and presentation was corrected, in order to give a clear visual sense of collison with projectiles and smoother gameplay
-Overall enemy health was rebalanced
-An error that made the Vsync functionality not be able to be turned off was corrected
-Increase invincibility duration after getting hit
-Corrected typos in the Stats screen
-Changed the ground enemies in A Cycle of Blood to make them not hit the player on contact
-Current software version now shows on title screen
-Other minor adjustments in stage balancing

notes.title: Beta Update 2
notes.content:
Achievements and cloud saves were added! Leaderboards are coming soon.

Other fixes include:
-fixed a bug that allowed entrance into a secret stage early
-numerous framerate issues
-added balances to Stages 3C and 4A bosses
-fixed a crash when player's died in the final boss 
-fixed bug in the Final Results screen

notes.title: Beta Update 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! INX Beta version was updated today thanks to your feedback. Here is what changed:

Fixed stuff:
-Fixed bug on acessing Secret Files
-Fixed up and down not working on the gamepad d-pads
-Fixed problem with FPS not showing
-Visibility issues in stage 2B were adressed
-Difficulty on Easy was toned down in the first stage
-Added option to show a timer indicating the minimum time needed to get bonus score on a boss
-Aspect Balancing: S.Tear and S.Tail damage were increased; F.Many damage was slightly reduced; A.Faith reflect window was slightly increased;F.Friend recall speed was increased; fixed A.Fury special explosion when dying, and rebalanced it's damage output.

Also, some players have been experiencing loading a version with content already unlocked from the launch; that has caused a number of issues, like controls not responding and framerate drops. If that happens to you, please use the option Delete Player Data on the Game tab of the Options menu.
